id.description: NC-01 for a major or minor nonconformity, OFI-01 for an opportunity for improvement

requirement.description: The one clause or Annex A control the finding is recorded against (e.g. 9.3.2, A.5.18)

statement.description: Statement of the nonconformity: what requirement was not fulfilled. Printed.

objective_evidence.description: The objective evidence the finding is based on, with counts, item IDs and dates. Printed.

deviations.description: The workpaper deviations this finding grades

management_response.description: Correction and corrective action the organization provided. null until it does.

summary.description: Statement on the conformity and effectiveness of the ISMS (ISO/IEC 17021-1 9.4.8.3 a). Printed.

scope_appropriate.description: Conclusion on the appropriateness of the ISMS scope (9.4.8.3 b)

scope_note.description: Why the scope is or is not appropriate. Required when scope_appropriate is false. Printed.
